scope: seed timeline; historical influence graph, not logical dependency graph

milestones.title: Old Babylonian problem mathematics
milestones.note: Place-value arithmetic and worked numerical procedures show sophisticated algorithmic mathematics long before modern symbolic notation.

milestones.title: Euclid's Elements
milestones.note: A durable model of organizing mathematics through definitions, postulates, propositions, and proofs.

milestones.title: Method of exhaustion
milestones.note: Finite approximations are used to reason rigorously about areas and volumes that anticipate limiting arguments.

milestones.title: Arithmetic with zero and signed quantities
milestones.note: Systematic rules for zero and negative quantities become part of algebraic arithmetic traditions.

milestones.title: Al-jabr as systematic equation solving
milestones.note: Equation-solving procedures are organized into a recognizable algebraic discipline.

milestones.title: Liber Abaci
milestones.note: Hindu-Arabic numeration and algorithms are transmitted broadly into Latin European mathematical practice.

milestones.title: Analytic geometry
milestones.note: Algebraic equations and geometric curves become systematically interoperable representations.

milestones.title: Calculus
milestones.note: Independent calculi provide general machinery for rates of change, accumulation, and local approximation.

milestones.title: Königsberg bridges
milestones.note: Connectivity is abstracted away from geometry, helping inaugurate graph-theoretic reasoning.

milestones.title: Disquisitiones Arithmeticae
milestones.note: Congruence notation and structural number theory organize residues, forms, and arithmetic relations.

milestones.title: Fourier's Théorie analytique de la chaleur
milestones.note: Functions are represented through trigonometric components, profoundly linking frequency, analysis, and differential equations.

milestones.title: Galois theory
milestones.note: Solvability of polynomial equations becomes connected to transformation groups and symmetry.

milestones.title: Algebraic logic
milestones.note: Logical operations are treated algebraically, strengthening the bridge between formal reasoning and symbolic computation.

milestones.title: Riemannian geometry
milestones.note: Geometry is generalized through manifolds and variable metric structure rather than a single fixed Euclidean space.

milestones.title: Rigorous real-number and set-theoretic foundations
milestones.note: Limits, continua, cardinality, and number systems receive increasingly explicit structural foundations.

milestones.title: Peano-style axiomatization of arithmetic
milestones.note: Arithmetic is presented through explicit primitive notions and axioms, sharpening the foundations program.

milestones.title: Foundations of Geometry
milestones.note: Axioms are treated structurally, with attention to consistency, independence, and models.

milestones.title: Hilbert's problems
milestones.note: A curated frontier list demonstrates how explicit unsolved problems can redirect mathematical development.

milestones.title: Incompleteness theorems
milestones.note: Sufficiently expressive consistent formal systems face intrinsic limitations on what they can prove about arithmetic.

milestones.title: Formal models of computation
milestones.note: Computability is formalized through precise models, enabling impossibility theorems about algorithms.

milestones.title: Mathematical theory of communication
milestones.note: Information, uncertainty, coding, and noisy channels receive a quantitative mathematical framework.

milestones.title: Modern qualitative dynamical systems
milestones.note: Hyperbolic structure, horseshoes, stability, and bifurcation ideas reshape the global study of dynamics.

milestones.title: Deterministic nonperiodic flow
milestones.note: A low-dimensional nonlinear model reveals sensitive, aperiodic behavior and becomes a central chaos case study.

milestones.title: Period three implies chaos
milestones.note: A precise interval-map theorem links a period-three orbit to a rich set of other periods and helped popularize the term chaos.

milestones.title: Computer-assisted proof of the four-color theorem
milestones.note: Large-scale computation becomes an explicit component of a major mathematical proof, raising new verification questions.

milestones.title: Feigenbaum scaling
milestones.note: Universal numerical constants appear in period-doubling routes to chaos across broad families of nonlinear maps.

milestones.title: Fermat's Last Theorem proof
milestones.note: A centuries-old elementary statement is resolved through deep connections among elliptic curves, modular forms, and representation theory.

milestones.title: Ricci-flow proof program for geometrization
milestones.note: Geometric evolution equations and surgery resolve the Poincaré conjecture within the broader geometrization program.

milestones.title: Flyspeck completion
milestones.note: Formal proof assistants verify the Kepler conjecture proof, demonstrating large-scale machine-checked mathematics.

milestones.title: Liquid Tensor Experiment
milestones.note: A difficult contemporary result is formalized interactively, showing formal systems can participate in active research rather than only post-hoc checking.
